svg.title: Dragon System Defence Boat - interpreted silhouette
svg.desc: High Guard Update 2022, printed 193-194, PDF 194-195. Two-deck envelope aligned by shared grid and common broad stern preserves narrow flat chamfered bow, long forward hull, broad aft shoulders and small stern corner steps. Upper bridge deck is shorter forward and remains within lower hull when stern-aligned; relative alignment interpreted and corroborated by illustration. Missile rooms, barbette symbols and machinery divisions excluded.
